purpose: Wide illustrative food hero imagery with full serving vessels visible

images.name: hero-kerala-wide
images.detail: Dish: Kerala fish moilee. A complete shallow handmade dark ceramic serving bowl with two tender white fish portions in a golden coconut-milk curry, curry leaves, green chilli and mustard seeds. A small complete side dish of appam may sit well behind the bowl, also wholly in frame. Golden curry and natural green accents. Elegant Kerala cooking.
images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: bespoke website hero photograph for MOOSA, a luxury private chef portfolio. Create a single photorealistic, ultra-wide landscape 16:9 culinary editorial photograph. This is a wide establishing tabletop view, NOT a macro or cropped detail. Camera well back, natural 50mm perspective, elevated three-quarter view. The COMPLETE serving vessel and ALL its edges must be visible, with at least 15% breathing room around the entire plate; main dish occupies only about 35% of the overall image width. Keep the whole plate in the central/right area, roughly 57% across the frame; left third is beautifully quiet dark negative space for website typography. Background: continuous obsidian and warm charcoal stone table extending edge to edge, subtle natural texture, warm low-key side lighting, soft believable shadows, champagne highlights, generous space. Realistic appetising food, refined but authentic plating. Deep enough focus to see the whole dish. No text, lettering, logos, watermark, people, hands, collage, divided panels, fake steam or cropped plate edges. One coherent restaurant photograph, no website UI.
